full_prompt_en: A square ink-and-wash adventure illustration shows a hat-wearing rider seated on a massive green reptilian beast amid loosely sketched vegetation. The composition is framed by a thin brown border over aged cream paper. The beast's broad armored head fills the left foreground, facing almost toward the viewer. Rounded plates cover its brow, a blunt muzzle ends in dark nostrils, and thick folds run beneath the jaw. Its muscular front limbs descend toward the lower edge, while a heavy scaled torso extends behind the rider into the right side. Olive, sage, and dark green washes gather in the recesses between plates, leaving lighter yellow-green surfaces on the raised forms. Above the shoulders, a stocky green-faced rider sits in a brown saddle. A brimmed dark hat tilts over his eyes; a tan trench coat hangs open over a pale shirt, belt, and dark neckwear. One hand rests near the saddle front and the other on his leg, with boots and hanging straps clearly visible below. He looks downward with a stern expression. Behind them, brown ink lines suggest dense branches, leaves, and tall stems, but the environment is deliberately unfinished and pale. Crosshatching, contour strokes, and small stippled marks build the creature's scales, the coat folds, and the shadow under the rider. The strongest detail stays in the central pair; the background dissolves into scattered line work and exposed paper. Light appears to fall from above and left, brightening raised armored areas and the coat while deep olive-brown shadows define joints and underside. The overall composition is weighty and adventurous, contrasting a solid green foreground mass with light sepia space and energetic drawing.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形墨线与淡彩冒险插画描绘一名戴帽骑手坐在巨大的绿色爬行兽上，周围是松散勾出的植被。细棕边框围住陈旧奶油色纸张上的构图。巨兽宽大、带甲的头占据左侧前景，几乎正对观看者。圆润甲片盖住眉额，钝宽嘴端有深色鼻孔，厚重皱褶沿下颌延伸。强壮前肢垂向下缘，沉重带鳞躯干在骑手后方向右伸去。橄榄绿、鼠尾草绿和深绿淡彩聚在甲片之间的凹处，让凸起表面保持较浅的黄绿色。肩膀上方，一名体格结实、脸色偏绿的骑手坐在棕色鞍具里。深色宽檐帽斜盖眼睛；棕褐风衣敞在浅色衬衣、腰带和深色颈饰外。一只手放在鞍前附近，另一只落在腿上，靴子与悬垂的带子在下方清楚可见。他低头看着前方，神情严肃。背后棕色墨线暗示密集枝条、叶片和高茎，但环境刻意没有画满，保持浅淡。交叉排线、轮廓笔迹和细小点触塑出巨兽鳞甲、外套褶皱和骑手下方阴影。最强细节留在中央组合，背景退成散落线条与外露纸面。光似乎从左上方落下，提亮凸起的甲面与外套，深橄榄褐阴影则界定关节和下缘。整体构图厚重而富冒险气息，以结实绿色前景体块对照浅棕空间和活跃线描。
style_prompt_en: The ink-and-wash illustration combines detailed contour drawing with restrained patches of earthy color on an exposed cream ground. Sepia brown, olive green, sage, tan, and deep umber create a narrow organic palette. Dense hatching and stippling gather around the central volume, giving rough surfaces and folds weight; peripheral lines become lighter, looser, and partly unfinished. Broad washes sit beneath darker drawn accents rather than obscuring them. Alternating rounded planes and sharp crease lines produce a sculptural rhythm, while a pale surrounding field prevents the textured center from feeling crowded. Directional light is described through unpainted highlights and dark olive-brown recesses. A thin frame and slight paper aging add an archival tone without introducing legible text. The overall effect is vigorous and tactile, with elaborate draftsmanship emerging from a deliberately spare background.
style_prompt_zh: 这种墨线淡彩插画把精细轮廓绘制与克制的土色斑块结合，奶油色底纸大片外露。棕褐、橄榄绿、鼠尾草绿、棕褐色和深棕组成狭窄的有机色谱。密集排线与点触聚在中央体积周围，让粗糙表面和褶面有重量；外围线条则变浅、变松，部分保留未完成状态。宽阔淡彩铺在较深的绘制重音下方，没有盖住线条。圆润体面与尖锐折线交替，形成雕塑般节奏，周围浅色区域让有肌理的中心不显拥挤。定向光通过未着色高光和深橄榄褐凹处表达。细边框与轻微纸张陈旧感增添档案气息，却不带入可读文字。整体效果有力而可触知，繁复绘制从刻意留白的背景里显现。
theme_en: A trench-coated rider on a massive green reptilian beast in a sepia jungle sketch
theme_zh: 棕褐色丛林素描中，穿风衣的骑手骑在巨大的绿色爬行兽上
name: Dan Spiegle
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
